notes.title: v1.5 Game Optimization
notes.content:
Optimize and compress textures to reduce the size of the game package, remove redundant maps, compress maps, remove redundant data, and greatly reduce the size of the game. The packaged game size is now only half of the previous version.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/96afba9b79347894091644df4e6a262c9e5361af.png"]

UI improvements

Performance optimization to increase frame rate

Enable vertical synchronization by default to greatly reduce graphics card consumption. You can also manually enable vertical synchronization in the graphics settings

Upgrade the project to the latest version of the engine

Optimize particle effects

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/80e3febd1833a61429922f31c1dd155bd9248dcf.jpg"]

notes.title: v1.4: New map and optimization
notes.content:
New map: Ancient Chinese style buildings and mountains.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/0fb6d960d25442c8f284c5754ad5ef0a0304935f.png
 Add the function to control the weather, press N to change the day and night and also change the weather randomly.
 Weather system improvements and optimizations
 Model texture material optimization, reducing game size and improving game loading speed
 Landscape optimization, scene detail improvement, plant LOD optimization, improved frame rate
 The music has been improved, softer and calmer, poetic

Improvements and fixes:

 Improved car driving, smoother operation
Added map loading interface
 Improved the reflection of the water surface, more beautiful reflection effect, reflecting the brilliant and bright fireworks.

notes.title: v1.1New menu and Dynamic Sky
notes.content:
New content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/c0acfc2fb018b0078b903291fabc45969ed4079f.png

 The new game menu can set the graphics quality and sound, mouse sensitivity, etc., support 2K, 4K, 8K resolution settings
 The new day and night cycle, you can switch to night mode in real time by pressing N in the game, and enjoy the fireworks feast in the starry night. The new sky has randomly generated dynamic cloud layers, and you will see beautiful sunrise and sunset daytime landscapes. In the future, real dynamic weather systems will be added, including rainfall, lightning, and snowfall.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/f2a6aac11c97c1e75f065f6a97789bd52f737a0a.png
 Add 10 wonderful music that plays randomly, you can set the volume of music and sound effects in the menu or turn off directly
 New landscape elements, beautiful flowers and plants, let you feel the beautiful spring
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/d2b21e460652fdb25ae45dfb36b2fce814324406.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/f8448a9ea221cf53fc71568d2ac405e350562bad.png
Bug fixes and improvements:

 Fixed the bug that the English localization of the game guide showed the language of other countries. I am here to say sorry to friends who use English, because of a small error in the localization of the engine, the release of this patch has been delayed for many days, Now the English localized content display works well.
 Improved footsteps

Upcoming content: female character and third-person view, new maps, etc...

We will continue to update new content in the future, thank you for your support, I wish you a happy game time!
